mentions.name: IntentEngine
mentions.description: This tool monitors Reddit in real time and pings the user when someone expresses a need for a product like theirs, filtering alerts so they fire only when purchase intent is high. Originally built for the author's own use, it now serves other users as a lead generation service.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on a reddit lead generator that pings you when someone wants a product like yours in real time, and It does so only when the intent is high.

Was using this only for my self, but i think it might be interesting for other people as well.
mentions.author: backend_dev82
